title: Winter is the best time to find a fossil on the Jurassic Coast
alt: A flat grey rock ledge on the shore, studded with the round outlines of fossil ammonites, with dark cliffs and the sea behind.

posts.facebook:
After rough weather, ammonites and belemnites wash out of the cliffs and lie among the pebbles. Book a guided fossil walk for your first visit, go out around low tide and search the loose shingle well away from the cliffs. Holding something that last saw daylight in the time of the dinosaurs is hard to forget.

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/jurassic-coast-fossil-hunt/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
